fieldnote.question: What is the required filter differential pressure for the YSC072 economizer?
fieldnote.produced: The required filter differential pressure for this unit is 0.5 in. w.c. measured across the bank at the design airflow.

fieldnote.question: What supply air total external static pressure should the YSC072 be set to?
fieldnote.produced: Set the supply air total external static pressure to 0.75 in. w.c. This value is the design point for the standard 3-ton to 6-ton configuration and is verified during the airflow test procedure in Section 6.

fieldnote.question: How long must the YSC072 be operated before the subcooling is checked?
fieldnote.produced: Operate the unit with the doors open and the economizer disabled for 15 minutes before reading the suction and liquid line gauges

fieldnote.question: What is the required nitrogen purge duration before brazing on a R-410A line set?
fieldnote.produced: Flow dry nitrogen through the line set at a minimum of 2 scfh for 10 minutes before the torch is lit

fieldnote.question: What is the minimum clearance between the outdoor coil and an obstruction?
fieldnote.produced: Maintain a minimum clearance of 12 inches between the outdoor coil face and any obstruction such as a wall, fence or parapet

fieldnote.question: What torque is specified for the YSC072 compressor terminal cover screws?
fieldnote.produced: Torque the terminal cover screws to 12 in. lb when reinstalling the cover

fieldnote.question: What is the maximum supply air temperature drop in YSC072 dehumidification mode?
fieldnote.produced: In dehumidification mode the unit controls the supply air leaving the evaporator to a maximum of 20°F below the mixed-air temperature

fieldnote.question: What liquid line filter size is specified for a 5-ton R-410A 48TC circuit?
fieldnote.produced: Install a 1/8 in. rated filter drier in the liquid line between the condensing unit and the evaporator on every 5-ton R-410A circuit

fieldnote.question: What branch circuit size is required for the 208V single-phase 3-ton 48TC?
fieldnote.produced: The 208V single-phase 3-ton unit requires a 40A branch circuit with copper conductors sized per the National Electrical Code

fieldnote.question: What is the factory charge weight of the 3-ton Carrier 48TC using R-410A?
fieldnote.produced: The factory charge for the 3-ton unit using R-410A is 8.5 lb. Field added refrigerant must be weighed in and recorded on the unit data plate

fieldnote.question: How many filters does the Carrier 48TC filter rack accept?
fieldnote.produced: The filter rack accepts 4 standard 2-inch pleated filters in the standard 48TC cabinet

fieldnote.question: What is the minimum acceptable voltage at the unit disconnect during startup?
fieldnote.produced: During startup the unit disconnect must show at least 187V on a 208V system

fieldnote.question: What is the required condensing temperature approach above ambient on the XC14?
fieldnote.produced: The condensing temperature should run 5°F above the outdoor ambient temperature at steady state

fieldnote.question: What superheat range should a thermostatic expansion valve system hold at rated load?
fieldnote.produced: A thermostatic expansion valve system should hold a superheat of 8°F to 12°F at rated load

fieldnote.question: What is the maximum ambient temperature for rated capacity on the XC14?
fieldnote.produced: The XC14 must not be used for rated capacity above a 125°F ambient temperature

fieldnote.question: What is the specified control voltage for the YK series controls?
fieldnote.produced: All YK series controls operate on 24V control power supplied from the factory control transformer

fieldnote.question: What is the specified minimum duct static pressure the YK blower is rated for?
fieldnote.produced: The YK blower is rated down to a minimum duct static pressure of 0.25 in. w.c. Below this value the wheel will stall and the motor will overheat on continuous operation.

fieldnote.question: What is the recommended cooling temperature differential on the YSC072 controller?
fieldnote.produced: Set the cooling temperature differential to 4°F for the standard YSC072 controller

fieldnote.question: What is the maximum allowable pressure drop across the liquid line filter drier during a pull-down?
fieldnote.produced: During a full pull-down the pressure drop across the liquid line filter drier must not exceed 2 psi. A larger drop indicates a restricted drier or a kinked liquid line and will starve the evaporator during a pull-down.

fieldnote.question: What condensing temperature should be targeted on the XC14 when the outdoor temperature is 95°F?
fieldnote.produced: When the outdoor temperature is 95°F the target condensing temperature is 115°F. The readings are taken at the liquid line at the condenser outlet and are corrected for the distance between the tap and the unit.

fieldnote.question: What is the specified torque for the YK thermostat setpoint screw?
fieldnote.produced: Torque the setpoint screw on the YK thermostat to 6 in. lb after adjusting the heating and cooling setpoints

fieldnote.question: Which roof was the unit that kept tripping on high pressure located on?
fieldnote.produced: It's on roof B, at the back of the building, next to the stairwell mechanical room.

fieldnote.question: What temperature did the technician say it was outside during the support call?
fieldnote.produced: The thermostat was set to 72 degrees and it was 97 degrees outside.

fieldnote.question: What did the support line tell the technician to photograph and send back?
fieldnote.produced: I will go photograph the nameplate and send it in.

fieldnote.question: What did the technician say had a brown crust on it?
fieldnote.produced: There is a brown crust on two of them.

fieldnote.produced: SETPOINT-18-DEG-F

fieldnote.question: What maximum amp draw is labeled on the 5-ton performance chart?
fieldnote.produced: MAX 4 AMPS 32.5 A

fieldnote.question: What subcooling target is labeled on the subcooling verification chart?
fieldnote.produced: 16 (TARGET 16 DEGF)

fieldnote.question: What field supply voltage is printed on the YSC072 unit 7 wiring diagram?
fieldnote.produced: FIELD SUPPLY 240 V 3PH 60 HZ

fieldnote.question: What disconnect rating is printed on the YSC072 unit 7 wiring diagram?
fieldnote.produced: 60 (DISCONNECT 60A)

fieldnote.question: What high-pressure switch setpoint is printed on the unit 7 wiring diagram?
fieldnote.produced: 600 (HP SWITCH 600 PSI)

fieldnote.produced: 55 (55 DEG F)
